prompt.title: Task / prompt
prompt.description: What should the Claude agent do? The agent will have access to https://mcp.apify.com (Apify Store) plus any MCP Connectors you select below.
prompt.example: Scrape the National Geographic Instagram profile and summarize the latest 5 posts.

mcpConnectors.title: MCP Connectors
mcpConnectors.description: Apify MCP Connector IDs to expose to the agent. Each connector is re-published by this Actor at https://<container-url>/mcp/<connectorId> and forwarded to the documented Apify MCP Proxy. Create connectors under Settings → API & Integrations → MCP Connectors.
